source_audit.title: Selmer groups as flat cohomology groups
source_audit.author: Kestutis Cesnavicius
source_audit.verified_claim: Bloch-Kato determine the p-infinity Selmer group of an abelian variety from the p-adic Tate module; used only as a representation-consistency cross-check

source_audit.verified_stored_input: under Wei Zhang Theorem 1.4 hypotheses, exact complex analytic rank two gives corank_Zp Sel_{p^infinity}(E/Q)>=2 at the same technical prime p

exact_result.statement: For an elliptic curve E/Q and prime p, with the usual Kummer/Bloch-Kato Selmer structures on E[p^infinity]=V_pE/T_pE and V_pE, corank_Zp Sel_{p^infinity}(E/Q) = dim_Qp Sel(Q,V_pE)=dim_Qp H^1_f(Q,V_pE).
proof_core: Kim defines the torsion and characteristic-zero Selmer groups using the corresponding E(Q_v) tensor local conditions and records the natural comparison induced by 0 -> T_pE -> V_pE -> E[p^infinity] -> 0.

Kim's compact-kernel/cokernel comparison, independently corroborated by Skinner's maximal-divisible-subgroup description, implies that replacing V_pE by E[p^infinity] changes only a full Z_p lattice in the source and a compact/finite quotient in the target.

If d=dim_Qp Sel(Q,V_pE), the image is a divisible p-primary group of corank d: the kernel is a full Z_p lattice because the target is p-power torsion, while compactness forbids a nonzero Q_p-line in the kernel.

The quotient of the classical p-infinity Selmer group by that maximal divisible image has zero Z_p-corank; hence the two size coordinates are equal. No Sha-finiteness hypothesis is needed for this corank identity.
exact_result.corollary: Under the exact hypotheses of the merged Zhang R9 theorem cell, ord_{s=1}L(E,s)=2 implies dim_Qp H^1_f(Q,V_pE)>=2.
